label: longEdgeFloors: the long edge's short side is floored instead of rounded
find: let short = whole(Double(n) * min(sw, sh) / max(sw, sh))
replace: let short = Int(Double(n) * min(sw, sh) / max(sw, sh))

label: shapeUnchecked: exact pixels that don't keep the artwork's shape are let through
shapeLoose: the shape tolerance is a whole long side, not half of one (#5326)
find: abs(Double(w) * sh - Double(h) * sw) * 2 <= max(sw, sh)
replace: abs(Double(w) * sh - Double(h) * sw) <= max(sw, sh)

label: shapeTight: the shape tolerance reads the short side, refusing a rounded size (#5326)
find: abs(Double(w) * sh - Double(h) * sw) * 2 <= max(sw, sh)
replace: abs(Double(w) * sh - Double(h) * sw) * 2 <= min(sw, sh)

label: gpsKept: All but location keeps the GPS dictionary
evenRoundsUp: an even-size format rounds an odd side up instead of down
alphaIgnored: a format that can't keep transparency takes alpha without a word
pathLeaks: a schema issue throws its JSON pointer again, not a sentence (#5834)
rawWanted: the plain sentence keeps the schema's "expected ..." wording (#5834)
